## In scope
Both calculations, saved recipes, export and import.

## Out of scope and non-goals
Timers, sharing, accounts, a server.

## Constraints and dependencies
Not applicable: none beyond a modern browser.

## Exit or retirement criteria
Not applicable: a personal tool kept while it is useful.
